name: @pipeworx/mcp-ohio-code

tools.name: oh_revised_code
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Ohio Revised Code — Ohio state statutes — by citation. "ORC 2903.02" is section 2903.02 (murder). Returns the statutory text (the section body only, with no surrounding page text) and its effective date as a separate field; `text_scope` says what a given answer contains. Keyless. Use for "what does Ohio Revised Code 2903.02 say", "text of ORC 4511.19", or to check an Ohio statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2903.02" or "4511.19". Title and chapter are encoded in the number.

tools.name: oh_code_search
tools.description: Search the Ohio Revised Code BY TOPIC or keyword rather than by section number -- "EDGE certification minority business", "county competitive bidding threshold", "OVI penalties", "landlord security deposit". Covers all chapters of the Revised Code. Returns ranked sections with citation, heading and an opening excerpt; call oh_revised_code with a result's section for the full text. Full-text match, not semantic search. A query with no hits returns found:false. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "minority business enterprise certification".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ohio-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ohio-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
